segments.name: Automotive
segments.quote: Automotive sector business recorded a revenue growth of 91% year-on-year basis, increasing its contribution to approximately 26% of operating revenue.

segments.name: Consumer
segments.quote: The consumer business contributed approximately 29% of our operating revenue for the quarter.

segments.name: Industrial
segments.quote: Industrial business recorded a strong growth of 86% year-on-year and 31% sequentially.

segments.name: Healthcare
segments.quote: Healthcare business grew by 61% year-on-year. This is actually a good margin business for us maintaining a stable contribution to overall business.

segments.name: IT and Railways
segments.quote: IT and railways also performed strongly while revenue growing by 69% year-on-year, 82% sequentially; its contribution increased to approximately 14% of our operating revenue during the quarter.

bull.point: Turned operating cash flow positive at INR120 crores, roughly 30% of EBITDA.
bull.quote: this quarter we have turned positive and we generated INR120 crores of positive operating cash flow, which is approximately 30-odd percent of EBITDA

bull.point: ODM revenue grew 117% year-on-year to INR591 crores in H1 FY27.
bull.quote: the ODM revenue in H1 FY27 is INR591 crores versus INR273 crores of the H1 previous year, which is 117% growth.

bear.point: Supply chain constraints expected to persist 6 to 9 months, easing only in Q1 FY28.
bear.quote: It is expected to continue for the next 6 to 9 months. And what the analysts, the trade, the industry says somewhere in Q1 of FY28, we could see some stabilization or easing of the supply chain.

bear.point: H1 EBITDA margin slipped to 9.9% from 10.1% last year.
bear.quote: Our EBITDA margin for H1 is 9.9% as compared to 10.1% last year

bear.point: Analyst flags PCB project margin assumptions as possibly on the higher side.
bear.quote: Possibly what margin we are factoring in our assumption that might be on the slightly higher side considering the industry dynamics.
